line.a_zapasy.text: I have my whole winter store! I'll put it away in my hollow.

line.a_nie_mieszcze.text: Oh no! I don't fit into my hollow. Only my head goes in!

line.a_za_mala.text: Your hollow is too small. You have grown, and now you have a big store.

line.a_nowa.text: You need a new hollow, bigger than the old one. Let's look for one in the forest!

line.a_jak.text: But how will we know which hollow is bigger?

line.a_metoda.text: We'll lay one on the other. The one that sticks out all round is bigger. The one that hides is smaller.

line.b_trzy.text: Look, there are three hollows in these trees.

line.b_najwieksza.text: Which hollow is the biggest? Point to it.

line.b_najwieksza_nie.text: That one isn't the biggest. Look for the one bigger than all the others.

line.b_sprobuje.text: The biggest! I'll surely fit in. Let me try!

line.b_za_duza.text: Brr! It's too big. The wind blows in and it's cold.

line.b_najmniejsza.text: And which one is the smallest? Point to it.

line.b_najmniejsza_nie.text: That one isn't the smallest. Look for the one smaller than all the others.

line.b_za_mala.text: This one is too small, even smaller than my old one!

line.b_sprawdzmy.text: There's one more left. Let's check it: we'll lay the old hollow on it.

line.b_wystaje.text: The new hollow sticks out all round. It is bigger than the old one!

line.b_wskaz_wieksza.text: Which hollow is bigger, the old one or the new one? Point to it.

line.b_wskaz_wieksza_nie.text: That's the old, smaller hollow. The other one stuck out all round.

line.b_w_sam_raz.text: Bigger than the old one, and smaller than the huge one. Just right for me!

line.b_myszki.text: A mouse family will move into Squirrel's old hollow. But their box is too small for their things.

line.b_pudelko.text: Which box is bigger? Point to it, and the mice will fit.

line.b_pudelko_nie.text: That box is smaller. The mice need a bigger one.

line.b_dziekuja.text: The mice fit in and say thank you!

line.b_lapanie.text: Acorns are falling from the oak! Catch the big ones, for the new store. Point to a big acorn.

line.b_do_domu.text: I have a new hollow and big acorns! Come to my house-warming.

line.p_start.text: Before we go, let's play big and small!

line.p_wiekszy.text: Which one is bigger? Point to it.

line.p_poloz.text: Let's lay one on the other and see. Which one is bigger?

line.p_wystaje.text: See? The bigger one sticks out all round.

line.p_najwiekszy.text: Which apple is the biggest? Point to it.

line.p_najwiekszy_nie.text: That apple is smaller. Look for the biggest one.

line.p_cien.text: Whose shadow is it: the big pear's or the small one's? Point to it.

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it big or small?

line.p_cien_duzy.text: Yes! It's the big pear's shadow.

line.p_cien_maly.text: Yes! It's the small pear's shadow.

line.p_czapki.text: Three caps: the biggest for me, the middle one for Owl, the smallest for Squirrel. Drag each cap.

line.za_duze.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_duze.sowa.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_duze.wiewiorka.text: That cap is too big, it slips off. Try a smaller one.

line.za_male.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.za_male.sowa.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.za_male.wiewiorka.text: That cap is too small. Try a bigger one.

line.d_parapetowka.text: Welcome to my new hollow! I'll make you some tea.

line.d_kubki.text: The big cup for big Fox, the small one for little Squirrel. Drag each cup.

line.d_nie_ten.text: That cup is for someone else. The big one for Fox, the small one for Squirrel.

line.d_pasuje.text: Everyone has a cup that's just right. Yum, tea!

line.d_rodzice.text: Compare the whole family's shoes with your parents: lay one on the other. The one that sticks out is bigger!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping me find a hollow! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Squirrel's new hollow. We found it when we compared what is bigger and what is smaller.
